rationale: The former stand-alone Buscar control is removed because client search now belongs immediately above the client dropdown. Its relationships clientId field passes onSearchChange:setContextSearch; a 250ms debounced contextQuery performs the same canonical reader. Shared SearchField supplies clear onChange('') and Selector close resets the query, retaining both search and clearing without a duplicated remote search form.
